integrity: The claim is proved analytically from the support-function sandwich, the source symmetry reduction, strict equality conditions in the one-parameter invariant optimization, and equality on contact orbits. No numerical sampling or finite enumeration is used to infer the infinite statement.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to origin-centered ellipsoids for the symmetric Banach--Mazur problem and to dimensions n>=3; it does not address translated ellipsoid pairs or global extremality of the Gaussian zonoid among other convex bodies.
title: Uniqueness of the centered distance ellipsoid for the Gaussian zonoid
